name: tmux_vim
description: vim -u NONE inside tmux (status off), single full 80x24 pane, after gg/O/insert/Esc/G. Client-leg redraw recorded; compared byte-for-byte (per-cell text) against tmux capture-pane -p -e.
how_recorded: detached tmux session running vim; status off; drove edits via send-keys while detached; captured capture-pane -p -e + geometry + cursor as ground truth; attached under creack/pty at 80x24 to record the full redraw; detached with C-b d.
